title: Project Manager (Construction)
description:
**Company:** Gambitz Designs  
**Location:** Thiruvananthapuram  
**Job Type:** Full-time

About the Role

Gambitz Designs is looking for a highly organized and proactive **Project Manager** to oversee and support the planning, execution, and completion of residential and commercial construction projects. The ideal candidate will act as the bridge between clients, site teams, vendors, and management to ensure smooth project delivery within timelines and budget.

Key Responsibilities

* Coordinate day-to-day project activities from initiation to handover.
* Monitor project schedules, timelines, and work progress.
* Communicate with clients regarding updates, approvals, and changes.
* Coordinate with architects, engineers, site supervisors, and subcontractors.
* Ensure availability of materials, labor, and resources on-site.
* Track project budgets, expenses, and billing schedules.
* Prepare progress reports and maintain project documentation.
* Conduct site visits to monitor quality, safety, and compliance.
* Identify project risks, delays, and suggest corrective actions.
* Manage vendor and supplier coordination for timely procurement.
* Assist in obtaining permits and approvals from local authorities.
* Ensure project execution aligns with company standards and client expectations.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree / Diploma in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or related field.
* 4-5 years of experience in construction project coordination or site management.
* Strong understanding of construction processes, materials, and execution stages.
* Knowledge of estimation, BOQ, and project scheduling.
* Proficiency in **AutoCAD**, **Microsoft Excel**, and project tracking tools.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Valid driving license preferred.

Preferred Skills

* Experience in residential villa and interior fit-out projects.
* Knowledge of local market rates and vendor management in Kerala.
* Basic understanding of structural drawings and MEP coordination.
* Client handling and relationship management skills.

Salary & Benefits

* Competitive salary based on experience.
* Performance-based incentives.
* Travel allowance for site visits.
* Career growth opportunities within the company.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Senior Project Manager

Experience: 5–7 Years

Location: Trivandrum, Kerala Hybrid Contract-to-Hire (C2H)

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior Project Manager to coordinate IT projects, manage delivery timelines, track risks and dependencies, and collaborate with stakeholders and distributed teams to ensure smooth project execution. Key Responsibilities **Define and track project scope, deliverables, schedules, resources, and dependencies.**  Maintain project trackers, status reports, risks, issues, and action items. **Monitor project progress, follow up on commitments, and escalate delivery risks.**  Coordinate offshore teams, stakeholders, and external vendors. **Facilitate project meetings and ensure timely closure of action items.**  Track defects, technical issues, change rollouts, and post-launch activities. **Provide regular project updates to stakeholders and leadership. Must-Have Skills**  5+ years of IT project coordination or project management experience. **Strong project planning, scheduling, and dependency tracking skills.**  Experience in risk, issue, defect, and resource management. **Excellent stakeholder communication and reporting skills.**  Experience coordinating distributed teams and vendors. **Knowledge of Agile methodologies and lightweight project tracking.**  Strong organizational, problem-solving, and follow-up skills. **Excellent written and verbal English communication.**  PMP, PRINCE2, or other project management certification. Good-to-Have Skills **Experience working with international stakeholders, particularly Canadian teams.**  Exposure to Calgary-based stakeholders and cross-time-zone collaboration. **Experience coordinating technical change rollouts and post-launch support.**  Relevant degree or equivalent practical experience.

Pay: ₹600,000.00 - ₹800,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Kerala Agri-university, Thrissur, Kerala
